Watchdog locations exclude locals/source text. Completed storage work may report actual progress without extending original deadline.

routes.title: 多次运行的汇总：时间花在哪一层哪一页、最常停在哪 / run report: where the time went and where runs stop
routes.boundary: Read-only arithmetic over events.jsonl: gaps between journal rows, attributed to the floor reached and the page of the last step; a gap over 120 s is a person, not the program. Runs are named by directory name only, with no account, device or local path. It measures time and stops; it does not judge whether a run was correct, and a bound the caller set is not counted as a stop.

routes.title: 任务日志逐步写出认出的画面 / the task log names every page the loop recognised
aliases: 看不到认出了什么画面
routes.boundary: Wording only. The journal already held every page; this prints one line to the log a person watches when the recognised page changes, when an input was sent, when the step stopped the task, and every tenth step on an unchanged page. Every registered page must have a player-facing name. It reads no frame and decides nothing; a line that cannot be printed is dropped silently.

routes.title: 运行历史：每个任务结束时记一行数据，截图没了也在 / run history: one row of numbers per finished task
routes.boundary: One row per finished task, appended to user-run-history.jsonl in the data folder: times per floor and page, counts read off the journal, the stop reason and what storage moved. A row names a task by its run folder and a game run by eight characters of its id; no account, device or local path. A floor is the sum over the tasks of one game run. It records and counts; it decides nothing about the game, and a row that cannot be written never changes the task's outcome. Only a run folder inside the installation is recorded.

routes.title: 任务结束时自动整理诊断截图：移到归档，不删除 / end-of-task reclaim: frames move to the archive
routes.boundary: Runs once after a task has written its result, while the task still holds the controller lease, with no game input. It selects with the retention rule that already existed and moves each frame to the archive beside the project through the hash-bound trail; nothing is deleted and no JSON record or journal is touched. The target is the warning line minus a headroom; a target out of reach is reported, not raised. The program never trims the archive, it only says how large it is. A failure here is printed and never changes the task's outcome. Only a run folder inside the installation gives authority to reclaim.

routes.title: 托管日程：今天还欠什么，按服务器日记账 / hosting schedule: what today still owes, booked per server day
routes.boundary: The ledger turns a schedule and the clock into the items still owed and remembers what was done. The Mirror task is its first caller: with a schedule chosen in the task's own options it plays only on the chosen weekdays and only until the day's complete runs are booked; a start the day does not owe ends before anything looks at the game. A run is booked only when it is complete (five floors, reward claimed, lobby reached), whether the loop finished it or the rewards task did by claiming its reward, and it is booked with or without a schedule. Without a schedule the task plays as before. The reset defaults (06:00 Korea time, week from Thursday) are stated values, not measured by this project; the game's own notice page is the authority. Not verified on the installed app yet.

routes.title: 镜牢队伍设置：关键词词典、出战顺序（跟随游戏或一键读取）、队伍星光 / Mirror team settings: keyword dictionary, deployment order (followed or read on demand), team starlight
aliases: Finish the active run before editing its team
routes.boundary: How a team is used in the Mirror Dungeon, two settings per team, each defaulting to "keep". Gift systems are ticked freely; none ticked ties the team to no system. The order is "keep", "game" (forget the saved order and deploy what the game shows for that team) or a written line. With no saved order the run reads the numbers on the twelve cards of the team page and records the order with the frame it came from in user-team-order-records.json and in the log; that record is evidence of what was read, it changes nothing. Ticked systems arrive as separate attach keys on one node, which the framework merges (measured). Edits are validated as a whole and saved before the next Mirror task starts, never for the team of a run in progress, with no device input. The app cannot show what is saved. Gift and pack preferences and the starlight plan are still edited from the Mirror task, for teams 1-20 only.

routes.title: 地图下一步：读游戏自己画的「>>」箭头 / map next step: read the game's own ">>" mark
routes.boundary: The game draws a double chevron halfway along every path the party may take; the node is at twice the mark's offset from the party. The party and the column pitch come from the train sprite, the mark from being grey on a tinted ground, relative to the ground around the party, so no theme colour is named. Marked nodes lead the candidate list; where another reader measured the same node its exact box is used under the mark's rank, and the other readers' remaining rows follow as a fallback. A mark is evidence that a node is reachable, not that a click was taken: the click result still decides. On a frame with no readable mark the older readers answer alone.

routes.title: 无人值守启动与收尾：模拟器预任务、记住模拟器、打开与关闭游戏 / unattended start and finish: emulator pretask, remembered emulator, open and close
routes.boundary: The pretask waits for the ADB address and then, when an adb is known (the remembered one, or adb.exe beside the configured program), for Android to report sys.boot_completed; without an adb it waits for the address only. It starts only the program the user configured or the emulator the detect task remembered, and accepts only a local address. Detection uses read-only manager commands beside the adb in use and recognises MuMu instances only; it changes no emulator setting and keeps four display values. Close emulator closes the one remembered instance at the connected address. Open game repairs an unproven start once and then refuses another. Shutdown, sleep and quitting the program are MXU special tasks. Live on 2026-11-26 on one MuMu instance: detect, open game, close game, close emulator and two starts from the remembered record each ran once; the boot wait ran once from source. Not yet seen: the whole pretask, connect and task list sequence succeeding from the desktop window with the boot wait in the packaged app. One MXU crash after a close-emulator list followed by an outside restart of the emulator was observed once and not reproduced.
